user.title: Connect to MeshCentral
user.description: If your account has 2FA enabled, create a Login Token in MeshCentral → My Account → Login Tokens and use those credentials here.

data.login_key: LoginKey (3FA) — leave empty if not used
data.use_ssl: Use SSL (disable if behind reverse proxy with tlsOffload)

data_description.login_key: Server-level LoginKey for 3FA. If your MeshCentral config.json has LoginKey enabled, all requests must include this key. Find it by running the server with --logintokenkey. This is NOT the same as a per-user Login Token (~t:... username).

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed — check username, password and LoginKey

abort.already_configured: This MeshCentral server is already configured

general.title: MeshCentral poll intervals
general.description: The device list also updates instantly via WebSocket push — these intervals only control the fallback poll and the hardware (getsysinfo) poll.

groups.title: Device group filter
groups.description: Choose which MeshCentral device groups to import into Home Assistant. Leave empty to import all groups (default). If you deselect a group that previously had devices imported, those devices and their entities are removed on reload.

categories.title: Entity category filter
categories.description: Choose which kinds of entities to create for each device. Leave empty to create all of them (default). Deselecting a category removes its entities on reload; re-selecting it brings them back under their original entity IDs.

error.no_groups: No device groups were found on this MeshCentral server
